h1: Multi-step agents that check every stage
overview: Big jobs fail when an early mistake travels unnoticed to the end. We split your job into stages, such as gather, draft, check and send, and build an agent that finishes one stage and verifies it before moving on. If a check fails, it retries, asks for help or stops. You get a diagram of the stages, the rules at each gate and a tested build.

faq: Why use several steps instead of one big request?
Small steps are easier to check and fix. If step three fails, the agent redoes that step without starting over, and you can see exactly where a result went wrong.
What does a check look like?
It might confirm a total matches, a file exists, a draft follows your rules or a reply stays on topic. We write the checks with you using your real cases.
Yes, in the Premium package, for example researching three suppliers at once and then comparing them. Parallel steps save time but make runs more complex, so we test them closely.
What if one stage keeps failing?
The agent stops after a set number of retries and alerts a person, with the stage, the reason and the data so far. It does not loop endlessly or push on with bad input.
